project.name: 轻伴 · 桌面宠物
project.designRead: Product showcase / contest submission / playful lively fun / medium density / avoid neon tech hero

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: Warm coral primary #FF6B6B + teal secondary #4ECDC4 + golden accent #FFE66D
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceDepth: Border-first static surfaces, shadow only on float layers

sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: static surfaces border-first, float layers may use deeper shadow

pages.title: 首页
pages.visualNorthStar: Bold playful hero with animated pet illustration, gradient text headline, bouncy CTA
pages.soulElement: Hero uses a large, cute pet mascot illustration peeking from behind a desktop window mockup, creating instant emotional connection

pages.title: 产品介绍
pages.visualNorthStar: Feature showcase with colorful icon cards, animated interaction demos, clean specs section
pages.soulElement: Each feature card has a small animated pet reaction icon (sleeping, eating, playing) making specs feel alive

pages.title: 用户与场景
pages.visualNorthStar: Persona cards with scenario illustrations, pain point comparison before/after
pages.soulElement: Before/after comparison uses playful 'stressed face' vs 'happy with pet' illustrations to show emotional transformation

pages.title: 价值与意义
pages.visualNorthStar: Two-column value proposition with metrics and emotional storytelling
pages.soulElement: Value metrics use playful number animations with pet-themed icons instead of generic chart visuals
